tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows gradient-dependent short-horizon gain, while the paid long-horizon observations show reversal. Fit competing two-timescale linear-in-amplitude models numerically, including gradient-coupled terms, and submit the best-fitting candidate for fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The acquired observations now span both short and long horizons, including reversal; fit and fresh confirmation are more informative than repeating these probes.

considered_alternatives.option: Haldane substrate inhibition or harmonic oscillation
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed sustained long-horizon reversal and gradient dependence favor a sink-coupled adaptation model over these recalled alternatives.
Gradient dependence is prominent, so the candidate family includes sink coupling as well as simpler uncoupled terms.
